purpose: 只按实际原JS POST接口和原DOM参数做四固定公开查询，不用凭据
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import json,hashlib,re,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_native_official_search_source_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
proto=readj(base/'protocol.json');queries=readj(base/'四原站内查询首次取得回执.json')['queries']
scripts=readj(base/'两实际公开检索脚本首次取得回执.json')['scripts']
api=next(s for s in scripts if s['url'].endswith('/api.js'));query=next(s for s in scripts if s['url'].endswith('/query.js'))
assert 'type: "post"' in api['source_text'] and 'search: "query/s"' in api['source_text']
assert 'siteCode: $("#siteCode").val(), tab: $("#tab").val()' in query['source_text']
targets=[]
for r in queries:
 s=BeautifulSoup(Path(r['path']).read_bytes().decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
 inline='\n'.join(r['all_inline_scripts']);m=re.search(r"api\.basic\s*=\s*'([^']+)'",inline);assert m and m.group(1)=='https://api.so-gov.cn/'
 site=s.select_one('#siteCode')['value'];tab=s.select_one('#tab')['value'];sort=s.select_one('input[name=sort][checked]')['value'];keyplace=s.select_one('input[name=keyplace][checked]')['value']
 targets.append({'economic_period':r['economic_period'],'url':m.group(1)+'query/s','method':'POST','data':{'siteCode':site,'tab':tab,'qt':r['qt'],'sort':sort,'keyplace':keyplace},'parent_query_path':r['path'],'parent_sha256':r['sha256']})
p=base/'实际公开站内数据方法及四请求前登记.json';assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'actual_api_source_path':api['path'],'actual_api_sha256':api['sha256'],'actual_query_method_source_path':query['path'],'actual_query_method_sha256':query['sha256'],'targets':targets,'request_method_and_base_from_actual_original_JS':True,'parameters_from_actual_original_DOM_and_fixed_qt_only':True,'no_credentials_or_challenge_scripts':True,'raw_count_before':6,'raw_count_after_max':10,'each_target_attempt_max':1,'new_stock_labels_or_fits':0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
def fetch(t):
 out={**t,'started_at':now(),'attempt':1,'raw_request_retries':0}
 try:
  r=requests.post(t['url'],data=t['data'],timeout=(10,30));p=base/'sources'/(t['economic_period']+'_站内原数据.json.txt');assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes(r.content)
  text=r.content.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace')
  try:payload=json.loads(text)
  except ValueError:payload=None
  out.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=p.as_posix(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content),full_response_text=text,payload=payload,status='PUBLIC_NATIVE_QUERY_JSON_CANDIDATE' if r.status_code==200 and isinstance(payload,dict) else 'UNKNOWN_NATIVE_DATA_RESPONSE')
 except Exception as e:out.update(status='REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
 out['completed_at']=now();return out
rs=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 for f in as_completed([pool.submit(fetch,t) for t in targets]):rs.append(f.result())
rs.sort(key=lambda r:r['economic_period'])
p=base/'四实际公开站内数据请求回执.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'requests':rs,'public_data_requests_actual':4,'authentications':0,'raw_request_retries':0,'new_stock_labels_or_fits':0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
for r in rs:
 print(json.dumps({'period':r['economic_period'],'status':r['status'],'HTTP':r.get('status_code'),'payload_keys':list(r['payload']) if isinstance(r.get('payload'),dict) else None,'actual_response_begin':r.get('full_response_text','')[:2200]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
